description: Call this tool to join several PDFs into one, in the order given. Page sizes are kept as-is, so a merged file may have mixed sizes, and the answer says so. Inputs are never modified. Free tier: up to 5 files per merge.

out_path.description: Name for the merged PDF; it comes back as a download link valid for one hour

overwrite.description: Replace out_path if a file is already there. Default false: an existing file is never overwritten

paths.description: Names of the uploaded PDFs to join, in the order they should appear

name: pdf_merge
title: Merge PDFs into one file
